rule_text: 1. (1) These rules may be called the Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) (Amendment) Rules, 2023. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. (2) In the Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021, in rule 3, in sub-rule(1),- (i) in clause (d), for the words "through direct sellers", the words "directly through a network of sellers" shall be substituted; (ii) after clause(g), the following clause shall be inserted, namely :- '(ga) "network of sellers" means a network of direct sellers formed by a direct selling entity to sell goods or services for the purpose of receiving consideration solely from such sale;'.
